title: SAP EWM Consultant
summary: Sets up and supports SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), the SAP module that runs warehouses: storage bins, receiving, putaway, picking, packing and shipping, plus handheld scanner screens and links to conveyors. Sits in an SAP project or support team next to the MM and SD consultants and works with warehouse managers.
dailyDuties: Run workshops with warehouse teams on inbound and outbound flows
Configure storage types, bins, warehouse process types and wave templates
Set up RF scanner screens and test them with warehouse users
Fix delivery and queue errors between EWM and the ERP system
Write functional specs for enhancements and review them with ABAP developers
Prepare test scripts and support integration testing and go-live

skills.expectation: Configure warehouse structure, inbound and outbound processes, waves, tasks, RF screens and MFS in SAP EWM
Know MM inventory and procurement well enough to design the EWM link for goods receipts and stock moves
Set up and troubleshoot the qRFC, IDoc and delivery links between EWM and the ERP system
Run workshops with warehouse teams and turn their needs into a fit-gap and design
Map as-is and to-be warehouse flows such as putaway, picking, packing and loading
Write test scripts and lead integration and user acceptance testing before go-live
Explain designs and issues clearly to warehouse users and project leads
Work with logistics, IT and vendor teams across project phases
Understand outbound deliveries and shipping from the SD side
Know how warehouse staff use SAP EWM or another WMS day to day
Write functional specs and debug enhancements with ABAP developers
Load storage bins, products and opening stock during cutover
Handle support tickets after go-live within agreed service levels
